title: Why register, which structure, and how to get ready safely

say: Why register, which structure, and how to get ready safely.
This is the video for module one of Business Registration and Compliance in Nigeria.
Registration turns your hustle into something the law, banks and big customers can see and trust.

In Nigeria, the Corporate Affairs Commission, the CAC, registers businesses under the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020, called CAMA 2020. Once your name is registered, nobody else can register it.

say: A business name is the trading name of a person or partnership. It is simple and usually cheapest. But the law sees you and the business as one. If the business owes money, you personally owe it.

panel.heading: Business name or limited company?
left: You and the business are one

say: A private limited company is a separate legal person. If it fails, shareholders generally lose only what they put in, not their homes or savings.
Under CAMA 2020, one person can form a company, and the minimum issued share capital is 100,000 naira, at the time of writing.

panel.heading: Business name or limited company?
left: You and the business are one

say: For example, three women in Lagos. Bisi sells ankara bags from home. She is one person with low risk, so a business name is enough for now.

panel.heading: Three women, three choices

cards.d: One person, small sales, low risk. A business name is enough for now.
Two owners, contracts, risk if food goes wrong. A limited company protects them.
Loans and an investor. Investors can only buy shares in a company.

say: Chioma and her sister will sign catering contracts, with a risk of a large claim if food goes wrong. A limited company protects their personal property.

say: Funmi wants an investor for her drinks factory. An investor can only buy shares in a company, not a business name.
Ask yourself: if this business failed tomorrow, could I pay its debts without losing my home? If not, think seriously about a company.

say: Most delays happen before the form is submitted. So prepare three distinctive names, and avoid words like Federal, National or Bank without approval.
Have your NIN, and use your name exactly as on your NIN record. Add a clear photo, a dark-pen signature and real addresses.
Use your own email and phone, and have a way to pay. Then you can finish in one sitting.

panel.heading: Registration readiness
items: Three distinctive name options
NIN for every owner
Passport photo and signature
Business and home address
Working email and phone
Payment method ready

say: Fees change, so always use the current fee shown on the CAC portal when you pay, not a figure from a blog. Pay only through the official portal.
If you use an agent, check their accreditation on the CAC website, and make sure the business is registered in your name, with your email.

panel.heading: Avoid registration scams
left: Fee shown on the CAC portal
Pay on the official payment page
right: Asks for your PIN or OTP
Your NIN in an open group

say: Be careful of people promising same day CAC for cash to a personal account. The CAC will never need your bank PIN or OTP. And never send your NIN, photo or signature in an open WhatsApp group.

panel.heading: Avoid registration scams

right: Asks for your PIN or OTP
Your NIN in an open group

say: To remember. The CAC registers businesses under CAMA 2020. With a business name, you are personally liable. A company is a separate person with limited liability. Prepare names and documents first. And never share your bank PIN or OTP.

panel.heading: Remember
items: CAC registers businesses under CAMA 2020
Business name: you are personally liable
Company: separate person, limited liability
Prepare names and documents before you start
Never share your bank PIN or OTP
